name: design-extract
title_zh: 一条命令扒下整站设计系统
tagline_zh: 改版时最烦的不是抄颜色，是抄完发现漏了间距和阴影层级。它把 DTCG token 拆成语义、基础、复合三层。
tagline_en: Copying colors is easy; missing spacing and shadow tiers is the real pain. It splits DTCG tokens into semantic.
desc_en: Extract any website's complete design system with one command. DTCG tokens, semantic+primitive+composite, MCP server for Claude Code/Cursor/Windsurf, multi-platform emitters (iOS SwiftUI, Android Compose, Flutter, WordPress), Tailwind v4, Figma variables, shadcn/ui, CSS health audit, WCAG remediation, Chrome extension. MIT, Playwright, Node 20+.
why_zh: 不是截图取色，是跑 Playwright 真读 DOM 和计算样式，所以能拿到伪元素。
why_en: It runs Playwright against the real DOM and computed styles, so pseudo-elements, state colors and breakpoints come through.
limit_zh: 本机要有 Node 20+ 和 Playwright 浏览器，装不上就整件跑不动。只覆盖公开可访问的页面。
limit_en: Needs Node 20+ and Playwright browsers locally, or it won't run. Only public pages; anything behind a login is invisible, and styles injected after.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: One command pulls a whole site's design system, Figma.
